main_body: Stack of cheese wheels: two wide wheels side by side at the bottom (rows 9-14) and a smaller wheel on top (rows 3-9)
top_band: Light yellow on the lower wheels, rows ~9-11, about 2-3 rows, only slightly lighter than the face. The top wheel has a light yellow cap at rows 4-6 with a small peak at row 3, but it blends into the face and does not read as an ellipse.
evidence: The wheels are drawn as blocky, rectangular, near-flat yellow slabs. There is no elliptical top cap, as the round_body guide requires. The lighter bands on top are 2-3 rows and tonally close to the front, so they read as a rim or hat on a front view. The dark brown row under the top wheel is a shadow or gap, not a front edge line. The lower wheels have a 3-row front face and a dark base with no distinct top surface. Under the strict rule, this fails.

style.evidence: The candidate uses about 3-4 yellow tones plus a dark brown line that leans toward the material, so the outline is acceptable. The wheel faces are large flat yellow fills with no grain, rind texture or per-wheel highlights. Each tile carries only about 3-4 colours, which is much less than the stall's cheese and the well, whose shading is richer. It looks thinner and flatter than the reference.
